helpText: The unique Settings Asset ID used by ItemFlavors. If you want to reference an ItemFlavor via playlist, just copy and paste the whole SAID00000000123 string.
A list of data for each tier of the ranked period. Must not be empty.
A Tier that is reached exclusively by ladder position. Can have at most one tier, that has a single division.
If this is selected, it will tell the game to pull a seclection from the 'Favorites' list
If this is selected, it will tell the game to reward based on highest watermark for this season
